## Parent

- #1734 — AKASHA-FALKOR-001
- Depends on #1735 — TRACE-GRAPH-FALKOR
- Historical/source contract: #1669 — TRACE-KIN

## Publication posture

`public` — deterministic observable trace analytics and backend re-proof. No claims about proprietary provider/model internal memory state.

## Objective

Re-prove the existing TRACE-KIN deterministic morphology/kinematics contract against the FalkorDB operational projection after #1735 is green, without changing the Rosetta-owned analytics semantics merely because the backing graph engine changed.

## Historical-evidence rule

#1669 and its existing Neo4j-backed proof remain historical evidence. Do not edit prior receipts to imply FalkorDB was the original proving backend.

## Scope

1. Run the existing deterministic TRACE-KIN metrics over the same normalized fixtures.
2. Re-run the graph-backed morphology, lifecycle, survival/disappearance/reappearance, and bounded pre/post neighborhood queries against FalkorDB.
3. Preserve all existing caveats: observable representation shrink is not provider/model internal memory compaction.
4. Differentially compare Falkor-backed query results with the expected literal results already established by the Neo4j proof.
5. Bind the new FalkorDB proof identity/version/configuration to the resulting evidence.
6. Update the active V0 proving path and docs/catalog references forward; preserve historical Neo4j evidence.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Deterministic TRACE-KIN result digests/semantic results remain unchanged for the same normalized inputs.
- [ ] FalkorDB reproduces all required morphology and lifecycle query results used by #1669.
- [ ] At least one pre/post neighborhood remains directly inspectable through FalkorDB.
- [ ] Representation-shrink / compaction-candidate classification remains based only on declared observable criteria.
- [ ] No temporal adjacency is upgraded into causality.
- [ ] Backend identity is recorded as derivation/proof evidence rather than analytics semantic authority.
- [ ] Historical #1669/Neo4j proof artifacts remain unchanged.
- [ ] Active Step 7 / Step 14 re-proof instructions target FalkorDB.

## Dependencies / handoff

- HARD BLOCKER: #1735.
- May proceed in parallel with the Falkor Graphiti successor once #1735 is green.
- Executable leaf.

## Non-goals

- Changing TRACE-KIN ontology or thresholds.
- Graphiti semantic extraction.
- Production observability.
- Hidden-memory inference.
title: TRACE-KIN-FALKOR: Re-prove trace kinematics and structural query parity on FalkorDB
